What moms want is something to show you appreciate them. A handmade gift is welcomed by most, but time is running short for that. Another idea is to give something to pamper themselves. Cozy robes and slippers are pretty easy to pick out. Sizes are easier to get right as you'll find many are SMLXL or one size fits most for robes. Error on the side of getting one too big than too small. This is also a gift you can repeat year after year, because they wear out. Another idea is a little basket filled with things like bubble bath, scented lotion, facial mask, hair conditioner, scented candle or potpourri in a pretty container, or even a relaxing massage or facial gift certificate at a local spa. You could also get her a something-of-the-month subscription she will receive in the mail for months to come. Fruit, snacks, nuts, coffee, and flowers are some monthly options. A picture of yourself or you and her together happy in a pretty frame is also usually appreciated. No matter what you get, include a personalized note telling her how much you love/respect/appreciate her, and why you chose this gift for her.
